name: Superior Cluneal Nerve Entrapment
definition: Entrapment of superior cluneal sensory nerves near the posterior iliac crest causing focal low-back/buttock pain that can mimic lumbar spine or SI pathology.

typical: Focal pain over posterior iliac crest

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is mainly clinical; diagnostic local anesthetic block may support localization.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Interventional treatment is selective after alternative spinal causes are excluded.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Entrapment of superior cluneal sensory nerves near the posterior iliac crest causing focal low-back/buttock pain that can mimic lumbar spine or SI pathology.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
